commands.name: agent-handoff
commands.description: Generate a context summary for continuing work in a fresh chat. Replaces the session system.

commands.name: agent-status
commands.description: Show current conversation stats — message count, token costs, task progress, next freshness check.

commands.name: agents:audit
commands.description: Audit agent infrastructure — token overhead, rule triggers, AGENTS.md health, Capability-over-Structure adherence, stale references. Read-only, suggest-only, never auto-apply.

commands.name: agents:init
commands.description: Initialize the agent layer for a consumer project — creates AGENTS.md and .github/copilot-instructions.md from package templates, auto-detects stack, never leaks other projects' identifiers.

commands.name: agents:optimize
commands.description: Refactor AGENTS.md to the Thin-Root contract (caps, pointer ratio, capability bullets, emergency-triage) and propagate to tool stubs. Suggest only, never auto-apply.

commands.name: agents
commands.description: Agent-layer orchestrator — routes to init, optimize, audit. Covers AGENTS.md and its multi-tool stubs (CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, copilot-instructions.md, .cursorrules).

commands.name: analyze-reference-repo
commands.description: Analyze an external reference repository (competitor, inspiration, peer) and produce a structured comparison + adoption plan for this project.

commands.name: bug-fix
commands.description: Plan and implement a bug fix — based on investigation, with quality checks and test verification

commands.name: bug-investigate
commands.description: Investigate a bug — auto-detect ticket from branch, gather Jira/Sentry/description context, trace root cause

commands.name: challenge-me:vision
commands.description: Stress-test a plan or idea by one-question-at-a-time interview until 95% confidence — emits a copyable Markdown vision pitch for tickets, roadmaps, or fresh-chat handoff.

commands.name: challenge-me:with-docs
commands.description: Doc-aware /challenge-me — 95%-confidence interview with session glossary vs CONTEXT.md, load-bearing claim-vs-code verification, optional CONTEXT.md patch + ADR candidates in the pitch.

commands.name: challenge-me
commands.description: Challenge-me orchestrator — routes to vision, with-docs

commands.name: chat-history:import
commands.description: Surface prior chat-history sessions as a numbered table, let the user pick one, read it silently, and emit a short summary plus a resume offer — selective, user-driven cross-session import

commands.name: chat-history:learn
commands.description: Pick a prior chat-history session and mine it for project-improving learnings — runs learning-to-rule-or-skill on the picked session, drafts proposal(s) under agents/proposals/

commands.name: chat-history:show
commands.description: Show the status of the persistent chat-history log — file size, entry count, header fingerprint, age, and the last few entries

commands.name: chat-history
commands.description: Chat-history orchestrator — routes to show, import, learn

commands.name: check-current-md
commands.description: Check the open .md file (or a passed path) for German outside DE:/EN: anchor blocks — umlauts, function words, untranslated quotes. Reports and offers fixes.

commands.name: commit:in-chunks
commands.description: Stage and commit all uncommitted changes in logical chunks WITHOUT confirmation — sibling of /commit for autonomous flows

commands.name: commit
commands.description: Stage and commit all uncommitted changes — splits into logical commits following Conventional Commits

commands.name: compress
commands.description: Compress .md files from .agent-src.uncompressed/ into caveman format and write to .agent-src/

commands.name: context:create
commands.description: Analyze a codebase area and create a structured context document

commands.name: context:refactor
commands.description: Analyze, update, and extend an existing context document

commands.name: context
commands.description: Context orchestrator — routes to create, refactor

commands.name: cost-report
commands.description: Capture token cost from the active Claude Code session, append to the local sessions store, and surface the 50/75/90/100% budget alert ladder with cost-profile suggestions.

commands.name: council:analysis
commands.description: Run the council on a local analysis output (project-analyze, audit script, codebase scan) — critiques the analysis itself for dedup, evidence quality, and roadmap-readiness.

commands.name: council:debate
commands.description: Multi-round council debate with progressive cost disclosure — each member produces a position, then rebuts the strongest opposing position in subsequent rounds. User confirms spend between rounds.

commands.name: council:default
commands.description: Default council lens — neutral framing, redacted context, advisory output only. Run `/council default <input>` for prompt/roadmap/diff/files; the cluster shows a menu when invoked bare.

commands.name: council:design
commands.description: Run the council on a design document, ADR, or architecture proposal — surfaces hidden coupling, missing rollback, and sequencing risk before commitment.

commands.name: council:optimize
commands.description: Run the council on an optimization target — perf hot path, memory pattern, query, or an /optimize-* output — for ranked, evidence-based suggestions instead of generic advice.

commands.name: council:pr
commands.description: Pull a GitHub PR via gh CLI and run the council on the diff with a PR-specific neutrality preamble — read-only by default; comment posting is opt-in.

commands.name: council
commands.description: Council orchestrator — routes to default, pr, design, optimize, analysis, debate

commands.name: create-pr:description-only
commands.description: Generate a PR description as a copyable markdown block — used standalone or by create-pr

commands.name: create-pr
commands.description: Create a GitHub PR with structured description from Jira ticket and code changes

commands.name: e2e-heal
commands.description: Find, debug, and fix failing Playwright E2E tests

commands.name: e2e-plan
commands.description: Explore the application and create a structured E2E test plan in Markdown

commands.name: estimate-ticket
commands.description: Estimate a Jira/Linear ticket before sprint planning — size + risk + split recommendation + uncertainty, sibling to /refine-ticket, ends with a close-prompt

commands.name: feature:dev
commands.description: Full 7-phase feature development workflow for complex features.

commands.name: feature:explore
commands.description: Brainstorm and explore a feature idea before committing to a full plan

commands.name: feature:plan
commands.description: Interactively plan a feature — research, discuss, and create a structured feature document

commands.name: feature:refactor
commands.description: Refine and update an existing feature plan through interactive discussion

commands.name: feature:roadmap
commands.description: Generate implementation roadmap(s) from a feature plan and link them

commands.name: feature
commands.description: Feature orchestrator — routes to explore, plan, refactor, roadmap, dev

commands.name: fix:ci
commands.description: Fetch CI errors from GitHub Actions and fix them

commands.name: fix:portability
commands.description: Find and fix project-specific references in shared .augment/ package files

commands.name: fix:pr-bot-comments
commands.description: Fix and reply to bot review comments (Copilot, Augment, Greptile, etc.) on a GitHub PR

commands.name: fix:pr-comments
commands.description: Fix and reply to all open review comments (bots + human reviewers) on a GitHub PR

commands.name: fix:pr-developer-comments
commands.description: Fix and reply to human reviewer comments on a GitHub PR

commands.name: fix:refs
commands.description: Find and fix broken cross-references in .augment/ and agents/ files

commands.name: fix:seeder
commands.description: Scan seeder data files for broken foreign key references — find constants used without getReference() and fix them

commands.name: fix
commands.description: Fix orchestrator — routes to ci, references, portability, seeder, pr-comments, pr-bot-comments, pr-developer-comments

commands.name: grill-me
commands.description: Alias for /challenge-me — interactive grill-style interview that sharpens a fuzzy plan/idea into a copyable Markdown pitch

commands.name: implement-ticket
commands.description: Drive a ticket end-to-end through refine → memory → analyze → plan → implement → test → verify → report — Option-A loop over the `work_engine` Python engine, block-on-ambiguity, no auto-git.

commands.name: jira-ticket
commands.description: Read Jira ticket from branch name, analyze linked Sentry issues, implement feature or fix bug

commands.name: judge:on-diff
commands.description: Run a single change through an implementer→judge loop with a two-revision ceiling, then hand back to the user

commands.name: judge:solo
commands.description: Run a standalone judge on an existing diff or code change — no implementer, no revision loop, verdict only

commands.name: judge:steps
commands.description: Execute an ordered plan step by step with a judge gate between steps — stops on first failed verdict

commands.name: judge
commands.description: Judge orchestrator — routes to solo, steps, on-diff

commands.name: memory:add
commands.description: Interactively add a validated entry to an engineering-memory file (domain-invariants, architecture-decisions, incident-learnings, product-rules)

commands.name: memory:learn-low-impact
commands.description: Preview validated low-impact entries that would be upstreamed to the package seed (default `--preview`); `--apply` opens a draft PR via `upstream-contribute` after re-redaction.

commands.name: memory:load
commands.description: Load ALL curated entries of a given memory type into the current context — opt-in full load for deep analysis, never auto-triggered

commands.name: memory:mine-session
commands.description: Mine the active session transcript for memory signals (corrections, preferences, decisions, recurring patterns) — preview-by-default, opt-in transcript access, host-agnostic via TranscriptAdapter.

commands.name: memory:promote
commands.description: Promote an intake signal (or provisional proposal) into a curated memory entry — opens a PR and runs the admission gate.

commands.name: memory:propose
commands.description: Append a provisional memory signal to the intake stream — the universal fallback for any producer (human or agent) to record a finding without committing to a curated entry.

commands.name: memory
commands.description: Memory orchestrator — routes to add, load, mine-session, promote, propose

commands.name: mode
commands.description: Set the active role mode — prints the contract, lists default skills, and refuses work outside the contract (see role-contracts)

commands.name: module:create
commands.description: Create a new module from .module-template with interactive setup

commands.name: module:explore
commands.description: Explore a module — load its structure, docs, and context into the current conversation

commands.name: module
commands.description: Module orchestrator — routes to create, explore

commands.name: onboard
commands.description: First-run setup for a developer on this project — captures name, IDE, bot-icon preference, rtk, cost_profile, and learning opt-out, then sets onboarding.onboarded=true

commands.name: optimize:agents-dir
commands.description: Manage the agents/ directory — scaffold, folder-audit, fix. Single command with three modes (--scaffold / --audit / --fix); default = interactive wizard.

commands.name: optimize:augmentignore
commands.description: Creates or updates .augmentignore based on the project's actual tech stack, large files, generated artifacts, and irrelevant agent skills/rules.

commands.name: optimize:rtk
commands.description: Create or optimize project-local rtk filters based on the actual toolchain

commands.name: optimize:skills
commands.description: Audits skills — measures baseline, finds duplicates/merge candidates, runs linter. Suggest only, never auto-apply.

commands.name: optimize-prompt
commands.description: Optimize a raw prompt for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or another AI via the 4-D methodology — BASIC vs DETAIL auto-detect, one clarifying question per turn, returns the polished prompt.

commands.name: optimize
commands.description: Optimize orchestrator — routes to skills, agents-dir, augmentignore, rtk-filters

commands.name: orchestrate
commands.description: Run a YAML pipeline defined under `.agent-config/orchestrations/` — chains personas / skills / commands / sub-agents per the orchestration-dsl-v1 contract

commands.name: override:create
commands.description: Creates a project-level override for a shared skill, rule, or command.

commands.name: override:manage
commands.description: Reviews, updates, and refactors existing project-level overrides.

commands.name: override
commands.description: Override orchestrator — routes to create, manage

commands.name: package-reset
commands.description: /package-reset

commands.name: package-test
commands.description: /package-test

commands.name: prepare-for-review
commands.description: Prepare a PR branch for local review — updates main and merges the full branch chain so the branch is up to date

commands.name: project-analyze
commands.description: Full project analysis — detect stack, inventory modules, audit docs, create missing contexts

commands.name: project-health
commands.description: Quick project health check — show status of docs, modules, contexts, and roadmaps without creating anything

commands.name: quality-fix
commands.description: Run quality pipeline (PHP and/or JS/TS) and fix all errors — auto-detects language from changed files

commands.name: refine-ticket
commands.description: Refine a Jira/Linear ticket before planning — rewritten ticket + Top-5 risks + persona voices, orchestrates validate-feature-fit and threat-modeling, ends with a close-prompt

commands.name: research:deep
commands.description: Read `outline.yaml`, research each item in batches, write per-item JSON validated against the project-local research-schema. No Python runtime, no `~/.claude/` paths.

commands.name: research:report
commands.description: Summarise per-item JSON results from `/research:deep` into `report.md`. Agent renders directly + emits an optional `jq` template for deterministic regeneration. No Python runtime.

commands.name: research
commands.description: Preliminary research scaffolder — pick objects, define fields, emit `outline.yaml` + `fields.yaml` for downstream deep research. Use for surveys, benchmarks, tech selection, competitive scans.

commands.name: review-changes
commands.description: Self-review local changes before creating a PR — dispatches to five specialized judges (bug, security, tests, quality, architecture) and consolidates verdicts

commands.name: review-routing
commands.description: Compute reviewer roles and matched historical bug patterns for the current diff, using project-local ownership-map.yml and historical-bug-patterns.yml

commands.name: roadmap:ai-council
commands.description: Challenge a roadmap with the AI council (deep tier) and refactor from convergence findings. Wraps `/council default` pinned to `--input-mode roadmap --depth deep`; patches surface as numbered options.

commands.name: roadmap:create
commands.description: Interactively create a new roadmap file in agents/roadmaps/

commands.name: roadmap:process-full
commands.description: Autonomously process every open step across every phase of a roadmap until the file is fully closed. Largest execution scope of the /roadmap cluster — runs continuously across phase boundaries.

commands.name: roadmap:process-phase
commands.description: Autonomously process every open step in the next or current phase of a roadmap, then stop. Default execution scope of the /roadmap cluster.

commands.name: roadmap:process-step
commands.description: Autonomously process the single next open step of a roadmap and stop. Smallest execution scope of the /roadmap cluster — one step in, one step out.

commands.name: roadmap
commands.description: Roadmap orchestrator — routes to create (authoring) and process-step / process-phase / process-full (autonomous execution).

commands.name: rule-compliance-audit
commands.description: Audit rule trigger quality, simulate activation, detect overlaps, and find never-activating rules

commands.name: set-cost-profile
commands.description: Change the cost_profile in .agent-settings.yml — shows each profile's meaning and applies the selection

commands.name: sync-agent-settings
commands.description: Sync `.agent-settings.yml` against the current template + profile — adds new sections/keys, preserves user values, shows a diff before writing

commands.name: sync-gitignore:fix
commands.description: Scrub legacy pre-`/agents/` patterns from the consumer's .gitignore (inside or outside the managed block) and re-sync the canonical entries

commands.name: sync-gitignore
commands.description: Sync the `event4u/agent-config` block in the consumer project's .gitignore — adds missing entries, preserves user-added lines, shows a diff before writing

commands.name: tests:create
commands.description: Write meaningful tests for the changes in the current branch

commands.name: tests:execute
commands.description: Run PHP tests inside the Docker container

commands.name: tests
commands.description: Tests orchestrator — routes to create, execute

commands.name: threat-model
commands.description: Run a pre-implementation threat model on a proposed change — enumerates abuse cases, trust boundaries, and authorization gaps before the first line of code is written

commands.name: update-form-request-messages
commands.description: Sync the messages() method of a FormRequest class — add missing entries, link them to language keys, and clean up stale ones

commands.name: upstream-contribute
commands.description: Contribute a learning, skill, rule, or fix from a consumer project back to the shared agent-config package
